chapter.verse: A masapenin mi khempeuh' ading thumna, thungetna, taangmi thungetna, hehpih phatna cihte neih dingin kong hanthawn hi.
Biakna lungsim leh a zahtak-huai gamtat luhek a namkim tawh a tawldamhuai, a nuam a lem nuntak khuasak i neih theih nadingin kumpite leh panmun lianpi a lente khempeuh thungetsak un.
Hih pen eite' Honpa Pasian' muhna ah hoihin pahtak-huai hi.
A hang pen Pasian in mi khempeuh hotkhiatna ngahin thumaan thutak cingtaaktak a theih ding uh deih hi.
Tua hi a, Pasian khat bek omin Pasian leh mihingte' kikal ah mihing mah ahi Khris Jesu a kici kamkhapna palai khat om hi.
Tua Jesu pen amahmah vekpi' taangin tatman khatin hong kipiatawm a, Pasian' seh hun a tun ciangin a thu a kilakcian ahi hi.
Hih' adingin kei pen thuhilh sya, (tua banah zuau hilo, thumaan ka genin ah) sawltak, leh Gentile mite' kiangah upna leh thumaan thutak hilhcian sya ahi dingin hong kiseh hi.
Tua hi a, mun citeng ah pasalte in hehna leh kiselna zang lo-in khut siangthote laamto-in thu a nget ding uh ka deih hi.
Tua mah bangin numeite zong a hoihbek omsiamna leh kikepsiamna tawh niklepuan a etlawm dingin kithawi ding uh hi. Sam kiphek hitaleh kham, kep, puan tampiman hihtaleh tuate tawh kizem lo ding uh a,
Biakna lungsim a pulak numeite tawh a kilawm nahoih sepnate nei ding uh hi.
Numei in niamlutna tawh gamdai-in thulela sin ta hen.
Numei pen pasal a hilh dingin leh a ukbawl dingin ka phal kei hi. Amah pen gamdai-in a om ding ahi hi.
A hang pen Adam kipiangsak masa a, a zom ah Eve ahi hi.
Adam in khem thuak lo a, Eve ahihleh khem thuakcipin thukhun palsatna sungah puk hi.
Himah taleh upna, itna leh sianthona thute ah kikepsiamna tawh a omkip uhleh amah in nausuahna tungtawnin hotkhiatna ngah ding hi.
